data.title: Free Client App: Meal Swaps & Health Sync | TrainZilla
data.description: Clients follow their plan free, swap meals with instant macro recalculation, and sync Apple Health or Health Connect to feed the coach's plan.
data.keywords: free fitness app for clients, client meal swap, Apple Health sync fitness app, Health Connect fitness app, recovery tracking app, macro tracking app

_rationale: Old copy was 100% meal-swap focused with zero mention of the Apple Health / Health Connect sync that actually lives in this app and feeds the recovery-aware AI Coach — this is the single most on-topic page for this cycle's focus area that hadn't been touched by a prior cycle. Feature referenced: Apple Health / Health Connect sync [PARTIAL].
